text.p: Salomon Brothers in a report released on Wednesday reiterated its strong buy recommendation for Israel's Orbotech Ltd, citing two recent orders the company won totalling $15 million.

Salomon said fourth-quarter 1996 earnings per share (EPS) would show a 31 percent increase from a year ago to $0.38, bringing the full-year figure to $1.49. EPS will grow to $1.73 in 1997 and $1.96 in 1998, it said.
Salomon put a 1997 target price of $22-$25 a share for the maker of printed circuit board (PCB) inspection systems and automated on-line optical inspection (AOI) systems.

"The two recent positive developments -- an $8 million PCB-AOI order and more than $7 million contract for FPD (flat panel display) inspection equipment -- reinforce our strong buy recommendation on Orbotech shares," said analyst Victor Halpert.
"We believe that Orbotech continues to demonstrate strong operating performance in its product segments."
